claim_checks.claim: Evernorth committed approximately 400 million XRP to native lending.
facts: The November 13, 2026 SEC 10-Q supplement reports approximately 346,284,972 XRP held as of September 30, 2026.
It separately reports approximately 388,910,554 XRP contributed in kind by investors in connection with the October 9 closing.
It reports approximately $91,397 unrestricted cash at September 30, 2026.
It says Evernorth had not yet generated revenue.
It says Evernorth had not borrowed under its $1.0 million Ripple revolving facility as of September 30, 2026.
The filing does not disclose a 400 million XRP native-lending commitment or lending revenue.
claim_checks.interpretation: The rounded 400M figure may conflate the 388.91M in-kind contribution at closing with a lending allocation. The filing does not establish that interpretation; do not record it as an executed lending program.

claim_checks.claim: Ripple Prime operates in DTCC alongside Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan.
facts: DTCC's May 4, 2026 Industry Working Group list explicitly includes Ripple Prime, Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan.
DTCC's Tokenization Service FAQ lists Canton and Hyperledger Besu as launch networks for 4Q 2026.
DTCC announced Stellar connectivity expected in the first half of 2027.
No XRPL/XRP settlement network is listed in those official service materials.
claim_checks.interpretation: Ripple Prime's working-group membership is real. It does not establish that DTCC's tokenization service uses XRP or XRPL.

claim_checks.claim: Japanese banks achieved live production corridors 60% cheaper than SWIFT.
facts: SBI Holdings' 2017 financial presentation shows an estimated remittance cost of 20.9 basis points for the existing system versus 8.3 basis points using Ripple's system with XRP, described as a 60% reduction.
The slide labels the figures as estimates and cites Ripple Insight from February 23, 2016.
No primary bank study or 2026 live-production corridor cost report was found in this run.
claim_checks.interpretation: The 60% figure has an official historical estimate behind it, but the video's framing as new live-production bank data is not established by that source.

claim_checks.claim: XRPL settled $3.5B in 30 days and $900M in one day.
facts: RWA.xyz's November 16, 2026 XRPL row shows $642.84M distributed asset value, $5.208B represented asset value, $5.851B total RWA value excluding stablecoins and 11.0% distributed.
It separately exposes Transfer Volume as a distinct metric from asset value.
The reviewed snapshot does not provide the video's claimed 30-day and one-day settlement-volume figures.
claim_checks.interpretation: Asset value and transfer volume are different measures. The video claim requires a dated transfer-volume export or primary ledger calculation; the current asset-value row does not validate it.
